title: How to Build an Event Management App (Ticketing, Registration, Check-In)
summary: Build a full event management app with ticketing, registration, QR check-in, and Stripe payments — without code. Step-by-step guide using Blink's AI app builder.
body_markdown: Eventbrite charges 3.7% + $1.79 per paid ticket, reaching $1,820 on 500 tickets at $50 each. A custom Blink-built platform eliminates per-ticket fees entirely — you pay a flat monthly subscription instead. You also own your attendee data outright: Eventbrite retains attendee information on their platform, while your Blink app stores it in a database you control.
